source_summary: Chinese landscape painting with mist-filled mountain ranges, layered cliffs, dotted tree textures, central wooded rocky terraces, foreground river with a small boat and figures, and lower banks with autumnal trees. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: central_towering_peak
motifs.description: Isolate the tall central mountain massif rising above the valley, including the rounded summit, steep layered cliff faces, ledges, and clusters of dark dotted pines along ridges and shelves.
must_preserve: fine ink contour lines defining folded rock strata
pale mineral wash and soft interior shading
dark pine-dot clusters on upper ridges and ledges
mist-softened lower edges where the cliffs dissolve into cloud
subtle ochre and green tonal accents on rock planes

motifs.name: left_misty_gorge_cliffs
motifs.description: Isolate the left-side layered gorge with pale vertical peaks, receding cliff silhouettes, lower crags, and dotted vegetation along the ridgelines.
must_preserve: soft blue-gray wash silhouettes of distant vertical peaks
thin curving cliff outlines and eroded rock folds
dark stippled tree dots on ridges and slopes
faded mist transitions between foreground and background cliffs
horizontal haze separating the cliff layers

motifs.name: right_receding_mountain_valley
motifs.description: Isolate the right-side mountain group with tall background silhouettes, rounded midground hills, ravine-like openings, and pine-dotted shoulders.
must_preserve: pale distant peak silhouettes at the far right
rounded contour linework of midground hills
small dark pine clusters on crests and slopes
misty basin shapes between the hills
light green-brown wash variations on the rock surfaces

motifs.name: central_valley_mist_bands
motifs.description: Isolate the horizontal bands of cloud and mist drifting through the middle valley below the mountains, including scalloped cloud edges and translucent wash passages.
must_preserve: soft scalloped ink outlines of cloud banks
transparent pale wash texture
irregular mist edges that overlap the valley floor
layered horizontal spacing between cloud bands
delicate fading where mist meets mountain bases

motifs.name: middle_rocky_grove_island
motifs.description: Isolate the central midground rocky island and wooded terrace with exposed roots, layered rock shelves, leafless trees, dark shrubs, red-leaf accents, and a sloping path-like ground form.
must_preserve: gnarled tree trunks and fine branching linework
dark rounded shrub masses with dense stippling
red autumn leaf accents among bare branches
layered rock contours and root-like formations
small pine-dot textures along the banks and ridges
subtle green wash on shrubs and ground

motifs.name: river_boat_with_figures
motifs.description: Isolate the small boat group floating on the open river, including the long narrow boat, seated scholar-like passenger, boatman with pole or oar, and the faint second hull/overlapping boat form.
must_preserve: thin ink outline of the long narrow hull
small seated figure in pale robe
boatman posture with angled pole or oar
delicate facial and garment linework where visible
faint boat edges and minimal water indication around the hull

motifs.name: lower_left_autumn_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left riverside bank with clustered trees, red-leaf branches, shrubs, sloping rock ledges, and pine-dot vegetation, excluding nearby seals at the page edge.
must_preserve: fine bare-branch tree networks
red leaf accents on the upper left tree
dark stippled shrub masses near the base
curving rock ledge outlines along the bank
small black vegetation dots on the slopes
pale wash modeling of the shoreline rocks

motifs.name: lower_right_willow_peninsula
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right small rocky peninsula with leaning willow-like trees, pale shrubs, a darker leafy tree, red accents, and low layered stone forms projecting into the water.
must_preserve: drooping willow branch linework
thin leaning trunks and sparse foliage
dark stippled central shrub or tree crown
small red color accents
flat layered rock shelf outlines
soft pale wash separating the bank from open water

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
